method: Inspect official active links and complete table of contents; text search all 98 PDF pages for financial-report terms to locate references; read and visually verify the complete relevant PDF pages 64, 66, 67, 68 and 97. This is document-boundary inspection, not full content extraction or semantic completeness review.
conclusion: The website-labelled Full Report is a complete frozen copy of the selected issuer Annual Report PDF, but is not a complete audited-financial-statements-and-notes package. It includes consolidated and unconsolidated financial summaries and directs readers to separately hosted statements.

financial_contents_present.title: Financial Status
financial_contents_present.coverage: Consolidated and unconsolidated balance-sheet-category summaries, brief classification notes and change explanations; not the full audited balance sheet and notes.

financial_contents_present.title: Financial Performance
financial_contents_present.coverage: Consolidated and unconsolidated performance summaries and change explanations; not an audited statement package.

financial_contents_present.title: Cash Flow
financial_contents_present.coverage: Cash opening/closing balance and net operating/investing/financing/FX summaries; not the detailed cash flow statement.

referenced_but_not_obtained.material: Consolidated financial statements and affiliation reports of affiliated enterprises
referenced_but_not_obtained.gap: No linked full statement PDF or affiliated-enterprise report has been resolved, frozen or reviewed; preserve language/edition/source scope when acquiring.

referenced_but_not_obtained.material: Pension/retirement details on pages 47 to 50 of TSMC consolidated financial statements
referenced_but_not_obtained.gap: External financial-statement page numbers are not pages 47 to 50 of this Annual Report PDF.

referenced_but_not_obtained.material: Significant contingent liabilities and unrecognized commitments in consolidated financial statements
referenced_but_not_obtained.gap: Annual report points to MOPS for the financial-statement disclosure. The printed URL ends in hom and is retained verbatim; section 8.1.7 separately provides the home URL.

unmet_coverage_claims.reason: No complete auditor opinion/report was located in the directory/targeted search and relevant sections inspected; the external audited statements package has not been acquired.

unmet_coverage_claims.claim: Complete audited primary statements and all financial notes obtained
unmet_coverage_claims.reason: Only summaries are present at sections 6.1.1 to 6.1.3, and other sections explicitly reference external consolidated statements and note pages.

inactive_links.treatment: Excluded from active link inventory; not fetched or treated as a verified available financial-statements source.

required_next_action: Before claiming audit/statement/note coverage, resolve and freeze the explicitly referenced financial statement edition as a separate source; do not silently substitute SEC 20-F or Chinese statements.
